title: Guangzhou's Beijing Road Hides 11 Layers of Old Road
description:
Beijing Road is Guangzhou's busiest shopping street — and most people walk right over its best secret. Set into the pavement, under glass panels, are the excavated layers of the old road: road surfaces stacked up from the Tang dynasty through the Song, Ming and Qing all the way to the Republic era — uncovered during a 2002 renovation.

It's free, it's easy to miss, and it turns a shopping street into one of the oldest continuously used roads you'll ever stand on. Look down.

🧭 Expert Tip: the glass viewing panels sit in the middle of the pedestrian street near the old Gongbei Tower remains — pause there before you dive into the shops.

广州北京路步行街下，玻璃罩里保存着从唐代到民国的11层古道路面（2002年修缮时发现），免费、却很容易被走过错过。你会低头找这些玻璃窗，还是继续逛街？
